paragraphs: The 740i has been a key petrol offering in the 7 Series range since 2015, spanning two generations under the same nameplate. Both the G11/G12 (2015–2022) and current G70 (2022–present) generations use the B58 — BMW's 3.0-litre inline-six turbocharged petrol engine. The B58 is widely regarded as one of BMW's most robust modern petrol engines, with no major systemic issues reported across its production run. It replaced the earlier N55 in the 7 Series range, bringing improved thermal management and a more durable closed-deck block design.
about.boldParagraph: The 740i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
